summary: Greenfire Resources filed a 6-K disclosing completion of a C$775 million rights offering to eligible shareholders, announced September 16, 2026. Each right bought 0.9167 common shares at C$6.74 or US$4.81; 114,985,163 shares were issued, the maximum allotment, for about C$774 million gross. Net proceeds repaid a C$575 million bridge facility and Connacher acquisition debt, leaving roughly C$570 million drawn on a C$1.0 billion revolver. The offering was fully subscribed, so the Waterous Energy Fund standby commitment went unused; shares outstanding total 240,413,692. Watch proration risk and post-offering leverage.
